name: Règles d'urbanisme (PLU)
author: ArchiSimple
description: Reads the planning rules that apply to a French plot: the regime, the document in force and its zone, prescriptions, easements and risks, with a link to the regulation — opened at the zone's page where the deployment runs the companion service, whose reading of the written regulation (on request) gives written rules to confirm, edit or set aside; under the national rules (RNU) and a carte communale, the coded rules, the Site boundary's edges, the R.111-15, R.111-16 and R.111-17 checks, the neighbours' height for R.111-28 and the setback bands; drawn prescriptions with a number and hand-entered rules to confirm, edit or set aside, saved in the project; the emprise au sol and surface de plancher under their French definitions, the footprint budget, extension caps, a capacity estimate and indicative procedure flags; and the programme warning that replaces Urban Rules.
